title: AreaJam Find a Local Music Teacher (Vertical Short)
ctaTagline: Learn directly from working local musicians.

scenes.headline: Learn from real working musicians nearby
scenes.subline: Hear how they actually play before you book
scenes.narration: Want a music teacher who actually plays the style you love? On AreaJam, you hear local players in action before you ever book a lesson.

scenes.headline: See local teachers & rates up front
scenes.narration: Tap Find a Teacher to browse verified local instructors right in your city with transparent hourly rates right on the card.

scenes.headline: Check their focus, schedule & studio
scenes.narration: Open their full page to see lesson rates, what techniques they teach, their gear setup, and their weekly availability.

scenes.headline: Follow or request a lesson in one tap
scenes.narration: Tap Connect to follow their profile or send a direct lesson request with your goals—completely free with zero middleman markup.

scenes.headline: Level up with a local teacher.
scenes.narration: Find your next teacher at areajam dot com—or add a free Teacher badge to your own musician profile today.
